unverified: THE HOOK DOES NOT FIRE YET. A UserPromptSubmit hook only runs once it is registered in .claude/settings.json, that file does not exist, and it is owned by bot-06-quality-security — deliberately, so the seat writing a hook is not the seat permitting it to run. Until that QUALITY change lands, everything here is reachable only by invoking it by hand. Nothing in this receipt should be read as 'prompts to LEAD are now uplifted'.

This does not cover messages that reach LEAD through the Grok Bot. A UserPromptSubmit hook is a Claude Code mechanism; an operator talking to the x.ai Grok Bot, or a seat messaging LEAD over the gateway, never passes through it. The stated goal — prompts 'basically always getting uplifted when we speak to our Lead' — is therefore met for Claude Code sessions in this repository and NOT met for the Grok Bot path, which would need the equivalent trigger at the gateway's /v1/intake or in the seat template. That is a second piece of work, not a detail of this one.

approved_by names bot-06-quality-security, reviewing after the work was done. QUALITY is the right reviewer and not a formality: it owns .claude/settings.json, so it is the seat that decides whether this hook is permitted to run at all. What it checked is in the PR comment — fail-open on every exit path, no secrets, state outside the repository, no bare except, and the narrow blast radius of a hook that only injects context. Both seats are operated by the same session, so this is an independent check of the diff and not an independent pair of eyes.

The TRIVIAL set is a judgement call about English, not a verified classification. It extends the three examples the skill names (ok, lgtm, thanks) to about thirty tokens of the same class. A short imperative that is not in the set — 'retry', 'again' — will trigger a full double uplift, and /desk-uplift-skip is the intended remedy rather than growing the list on every miss.
rollback_plan: Revert the commit, or simply do not register the hook in .claude/settings.json. Because registration is a separate QUALITY-owned change, this PR is inert on merge: the files sit in the tree and nothing invokes them. That is the rollback — a revert is only needed to remove the files themselves.
